why: All three checks pass. It is a one-sentence line, so there is no second half reversing it; the neighbouring line 456 strengthens rather than weakens the claim ("When you first run Fable 5, Opus 4.8, or Opus 4.7, Claude Code applies that model's default effort even if you previously set a different level for another model, and holds it across sessions until you make an explicit effort choice ... Opus 5 has no such hold"). (2) CITED LINE: packages/shared/src/agent/thinking-levels.ts:63 is `export const DEFAULT_THINKING_LEVEL: ThinkingLevel = 'medium';` as claimed. (3) CONSEQUENCE, verified separately from the identifier and in both directions. One layer down: resolveEffortLevel (thinking-levels.ts:200-206) ends `?? input.fallback ?? DEFAULT_THINKING_LEVEL` with no model argument at all; the only model-aware rule in the file, clampThinkingLevelToModel + NARROWED_EFFORT_MODELS (:220-247), implements model-config.md:452 and only ever LOWERS an already-chosen level - it is not a default source. One layer up: SessionManager.ts:8900-8903 resolves caller -> trusted project default -> workspace default -> getDefaultThinkingLevel(), and getDefaultThinkingLevel (config/storage.ts:2481-2489) reads config.defaultThinkingLevel then bundled config-defaults, never the model id. apps/electron/resources/config-defaults.json:23 ships "thinkingLevel": "think", which normalizeThinkingLevel maps to 'medium', so the shipped effective default really is medium. base-agent.ts:473 uses the same constant. `grep -a` for defaultEffort/defaultThinking across the repo finds no per-model default field anywhere, and no hold/explicit-choice flag exists in thinking-levels.ts or SessionManager. correctedState: Accurate as filed, with one refinement. The default is not a bare constant in practice: it resolves through caller -> trusted project default -> workspace default -> app config `defaultThinkingLevel` -> bundled `config-defaults.json` (`"think"`, normalized to `medium`) -> `DEFAULT_THINKING_LEVEL` (thinking-levels.ts:63). It is therefore user- and workspace-configurable, but at no point in that chain is the model id an input, and the shipped value is `medium`. There is no per-model default (no `defaultEffort` in `MODEL_REGISTRY`; `clampThinkingLevelToModel`/`NARROWED_EFFORT_MODELS` only narrow a level already chosen, per model-config.md:452) and no persisted explicit-choice flag, so the model-default hold of model-config.md:456 cannot exist either. Already carried at deviation-register:100 and plans/2026-07-29-effort-precedence.md:180 - report it as a duplicate of a recorded deviation, not as a new finding.
